div.p: Introduction to pranayama: how conscious breathing can support your physical, mental and emotional wellbeing. Suitable for beginners, no previous Yoga or Breathwork experience required. Led by Ania Zielińska.

img.alt: Breath as a medicine — online pranayama workshop with Ania Zielińska, 15 December 2026, 7–9pm Singapore time

figure.figcaption: Tap to open the full-size poster to save or share it.

div.p: In this introductory workshop, you’ll learn what pranayama is and how conscious breathing can support your physical, mental and emotional wellbeing.

We’ll explore the connection between the breath, nervous system and state of mind, and you’ll be introduced to a selection of simple pranayama techniques that can be used in everyday life — whether you need to calm down, reset, energise and invigorate your body, improve focus or create a greater sense of presence.
The workshop is suitable for beginners and no previous Yoga or Breathwork experience is required.

ul.li: Learn what pranayama means and why breath awareness is an incredible tool to be used in everyday life
Discover breathwork as a powerful medicine
Explore how different breathing patterns can influence your state of mind and body
Practice simple and accessible pranayama techniques
Learn practical techniques you can incorporate into your daily routine or working day

div.p: Come as you are, with no expectations or previous experience — just bring your curiosity and your breath.
Anybody interested to know more about pranayama. No previous Yoga or Breathwork experience is needed.

div.span: Yoga Teacher · Holistic Health Coach · Life Realignment Mentor
div.p: Ania Zielińska (Sunrise) is a Yoga Teacher, Holistic Health Coach and Life Realignment Mentor with over a decade of experience in Yoga, meditation and holistic wellbeing. She has completed over 700 hours of yoga teacher training and teaches Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin Yoga, alongside pranayama and meditation.

Her work goes beyond the physical practice of Yoga. As a Life Realignment Mentor, Ania supports people in creating meaningful changes across different areas of life — from wellbeing and weight loss, habits and mindset to self-awareness, relationships and personal growth. Her approach combines traditional Yogic practices with practical tools that can be integrated into everyday life, helping people cultivate greater awareness, calm, focus, energy and connection with themselves.

Ania’s own journey with Yoga began as a profound personal transformation and has grown into a passion for guiding others Back to Themselves through movement, breath and mindfulness. She has taught Yoga internationally both in-person and online, and she works with people from different backgrounds and levels of experience.
She believes that breath is one of the simplest and most powerful tools we have available to influence how we feel, respond and move through our day.
